actual_condition_recorded_truthfully.statement: Held-out human labels exist in plaintext on the canonical HD archive. They are not physically inaccessible.
actual_condition_recorded_truthfully.deletion_refused_because: Deleting or moving historical held-out plaintext purely to create the appearance of blindness would manufacture a false evidentiary condition. The real condition is recorded instead.
actual_condition_recorded_truthfully.operational_consequence: Blindness is enforced by PROCESS, not by physical absence: explicit prohibited paths, code-level access restriction, audited file-open behaviour, and prediction-before-reveal provenance.
actual_condition_recorded_truthfully.verification_method: Presence and size only (stat/stat) was used to establish which answer-bearing artifacts exist. NO answer-bearing file content was opened, read, parsed or inferred during this task.

prohibited_answer_bearing_paths.note: Every path below was confirmed to exist on disk by stat. These are the REAL files, not placeholder names. Tests fail if this list drifts away from disk.

authorized_label_free_inputs_for_predict.role: MEMBERSHIP ONLY; no stable class, no answer

predictor_file_access_audit.method: Python sys.addaudithook tracing every 'open' audit event, including io/Path mechanisms that bypass builtins.open.
predictor_file_access_audit.inputs: SYNTHETIC feature records and one confirmed DEVELOPMENT item. No held-out identifier used.
predictor_file_access_audit.scoring_purity: score() performs NO file access once the spec is in memory.

held_out_unstable_membership_blindness.public_fact: The global set of 10 human-unstable item numbers is public.
held_out_unstable_membership_blindness.readable_fact: The 8 development-unstable identities are readable from the authorized development label source.
held_out_unstable_membership_blindness.logical_consequence: The two held-out-unstable identities are logically derivable by set difference.
held_out_unstable_membership_blindness.qualification_required_on_future_reporti: This condition does NOT reveal the stable held-out YES/NO answers, and it does NOT affect binary scoring: human-unstable held-out cases are already excluded from binary scoring by the preregistered methodology.
held_out_unstable_membership_blindness.split_redesign_note: The 40/20 split is NOT redesigned. The split was sealed before the classifier existed.

backup_tool_gap.consequence: Mirror contents are not a secrecy boundary and must never be treated as one.
backup_tool_gap.remediation_in_this_task: None. Deleting mirror orphans is forbidden by the authority document, and rewriting the shared backup tool is outside this task's scope.

enforcement_layers: 1. Explicit prohibited-path list bound to real on-disk artifacts.
2. Runtime audit-hook test that fails if pre-reveal scoring opens any prohibited path.
3. Anti-vacuity test that fails if the prohibited list stops matching disk.
4. Static AST check that no answer-bearing filename appears in executable code (docstrings excluded).
5. Prediction artifact must not carry any label field; scoring rejects it otherwise.
6. Prediction artifact hashed and externally backed BEFORE reveal authorization.
7. Reveal and scoring are separate, individually authorized, ordered gates.
